description: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Formally known as EBT or Food Stamps  is a Federal program that aims to help individuals and families help pay for food.
whatThisIs: This program gives you cash assistance by way of a physical card similar to a debit or credit card to spend on food in approved grocery, pharmacy, and farmer markets.
relatedLinkExplanation: HIP (Healthy Incentives Program ) is a supplementary program that allows you to spend your SNAP/EBT money at select farmers Markets., Eligibility Checker
whoItHelps: Anyone who is currently struggling to find food in the budget.
whatItHelps: Help Cover the Cost of Food, Can help Cover the Cost of certain Baby Formulas
